question: Is customer data in your production database encrypted at rest?
Are encryption keys rotated automatically?
Is all customer data stored in object storage (e.g. S3) encrypted at rest?
Is data in transit encrypted with TLS 1.2 or higher?
Are plain HTTP requests redirected to HTTPS?
Do you send an HSTS header on your web application?
Are connections between your application and database encrypted?
Is multi-factor authentication required for administrative access?
Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all workforce users?
Do employees sign in through single sign-on (SSO)?
Do you enforce a minimum password length of at least 12 characters?
Do you prevent reuse of previous passwords?
Do administrative sessions time out after inactivity?
Is access granted on a least-privilege basis (e.g. read-only roles for auditors)?
Are production code changes peer-reviewed before merge?
Do you keep an audit log of administrative actions across all regions?
Are audit logs protected against tampering?
Are logs retained for at least 12 months?
Do you capture network flow logs for your production network?
Do you take automated backups of customer data?
Is your production database deployed across multiple availability zones?
Is the production database protected against accidental deletion?
Is versioning enabled on storage that holds customer files?
Is public access blocked on all storage buckets?
Is a web application firewall (WAF) in front of your application?
Is your production database isolated from the public internet?
Is database access restricted to the application tier only?
Do you run static application security testing (SAST) on every change?
Do you monitor third-party dependencies for known vulnerabilities?
Do you scan code for committed secrets?
Are container images scanned for vulnerabilities before deployment?
Do you have a public channel for reporting security vulnerabilities?
Do you test restoring from backups at least annually?
Has an independent third party performed a penetration test in the last 12 months?
Is your disaster recovery plan tested at least annually?
Is endpoint protection (EDR/antivirus) installed on all employee devices?
Do you delete customer data on request and at contract termination?
Do employees with access to customer data undergo background checks?
Within how many hours will you notify us after confirming a data breach?
What monthly uptime do you commit to for the production service?
